description: Use while building an approved slide to source a logo, icon or photo for an image slot (see get_playbook). Searches public-domain logo SVGs (Wikimedia Commons, Simple Icons), permissive icon SVGs (Iconify) and CC0, public-domain and CC BY photos (Openverse). Returns up to k results, each with its title, licence and either the SVG text or the photo's download and page links, plus a credit line only when the licence requires one; photo thumbnails follow as images.

k.description: How many results, 1 to 4 (default 3; 4 for icons).

kind.description: logo: a brand's mark; icon: a pictogram of an object; photo: a photograph.

query.description: A brand name, the object an icon draws ("truck", not "logistics"), or what a photo shows.

name: find_images
title: Find images for a slide
